notes.title: FIX UPDATE
MAJOR UPDATE v4
MAJOR UPDATE!
MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear Players!

Week after release, we're still working on game improvements and there are few updates ahead! (you even can't imagine how much our paws are exhausted....)

Ok, let's not runaround and jump into changelog:


 Reduced size of the game. At the moment game is 3.9 GB (was 10.6 GB) (in the next build, the weight will be even slightly less)
 Amount of souls (spheres/points) needed for Altars is rebalanced
 Slightly improved animations of spirits (still more improvements ahead)
 Some missing text translations are added
 Improved souls (spheres/points) counting animation
 At first minigame (with different color spheres) player is able to collect all or few spheres at the same time
 Minor bugs fixed


Sincerely,
Dev Team 🐺🐾
